name: research-digest-mobile
description: Research Digest for Android and iOS. The engine runs on the phone; no server, keys or accounts.

scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap add android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android && npx cap sync android && node scripts/set-version.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/set-version.mjs
